messages:
Maya R: Quick heads-up — doing an emergency drill tomorrow to exercise snapshot decrypts + RBAC edgecases after last week's CMK roll. Goal: prove we can restore a small read-only snapshot and detect any audit gaps. Plan below.

Jorge P: 👍 what window?

Maya R: 10:30am PST, 30m box. We'll run in staging then a limited prod-sim (no sensitive data). Expect 3 parts: 1) ephemeral grant create/expire, 2) restore snapshot from blobstore (S3/GCS) with CMK, 3) audit log verification queries.

Anna L: Can we avoid touching the production CMK? Use a test CMK but also simulate grant propagation to the prod keystore mapping so we check principal mapping logic.

Maya R: Yes — test CMK for decrypts. We'll include a dry-run that replays the prod grant mapping lookup path (no real decrypt).

Samir K: I can add an ephemeral grant helper. Quick snippet I use in staging: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/redwood-backup-test --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/backup-restore-staging --operations Decrypt --constraints 'EncryptionContextSubset={"purpose":"restore-drill"}'
```
I'll also add a small helper to retire the grant after 5 minutes.

Kevin H: When we simulate expire, make sure the KMS audit shows Revoke/Retire events. CloudTrail sometimes lags — include a 2nd check after 2 mins.

Maya R: Good call. We'll capture CloudTrail : kms:Decrypt and kms:RetireGrant, plus S3 GetObject events with x-amz-server-side-encryption headers. Query plan: Athena SQL for s3:GetObject where requestParameters includes serverSideEncryption or CloudTrail eventName = "Decrypt".

Anna L: Also validate that role mappings (the service account -> iam role) are respected. There was a drift earlier where staging uids weren't in the tenant map and we saw implicit deny. Add a check for "sts:AssumeRole" success events from the backup-restore role.

Jorge P: On RBAC changes — we recently merged the allow-list for backup operators. Can we run the drill with and without the new policy attached to ensure fail-open/fail-closed behavior?

Maya R: Yes: test matrix: A) policy attached (expected success), B) policy removed (expected denied, audit entry), C) ephemeral grant expired (expected denied + specific KMS error). We'll document exact expected event names.

Samir K: One gotcha — S3 multipart restores sometimes strip SSE headers in multipart reassembly path. For the drill, use single-part small snapshot to keep telemetry clear.

encops-bot: Reminder: scheduled drill: 2024-06-15T17:30:00Z (corresponds to 10:30am PST). Please acknowledge if you'll be on-call.

Kevin H: Acknowledged. I'll monitor CloudTrail and the SIEM dashboard. Will add ad-hoc detection: 
```
index=cloudtrail eventName="Decrypt" OR eventName="RetireGrant" OR eventName="GetObject" | stats count by eventName, userIdentity.arn
```
Anna L: I'll run the RBAC smoke test and the grant-retire verifier. If anything shows unexpected 403s, we pause.

Maya R: TL;DR: 10:30am PST drill, staging test CMK + prod-mapping replay, ephemeral grant create/expire, single-part restore, run audit queries (CloudTrail/Athena/SIEM). Postmortem doc stub: /docs/encops/drills/snapshot-keystore-drill-2024-06.md (I'll create).

Jorge P: adding a quick checklist: 1) create ephemeral grant (Samir) 2) upload test snapshot (Maya) 3) run restore (Anna) 4) verify CloudTrail Athena queries (Kevin) 5) retire grant and verify RetireGrant logs (Samir) 6) collect logs, open postmortem (Maya).

Samir K: I'll push the ephemeral grant script to staging branch and tag the run with correlation_id=drill-1717432100.

Maya R: Perfect. If anyone sees unexpected cleartext uploads or missing sse metadata in S3 events, stop immediately and notify sec-oncall.

Kevin H: I'll keep a quick query ready to detect missing sse headers: 
```
SELECT eventTime, userIdentity, requestParameters, errorCode FROM cloudtrail WHERE eventName='GetObject' AND NOT requestParameters LIKE '%serverSideEncryption%';
```
Anna L: RSVP: I'll be on-call for the restore step.

Jorge P: FYI ops-runbook note: ensure key alias rotation doesn't collide with the test alias. Use alias/redwood-backup-test-<runid>.

Maya R: thanks. I'll pin the run steps and post the postmortem link after. Expect a short follow-up thread with collected queries and expected result samples. :white_check_mark:
